newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Cash offers weaken.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Cash offers weaken.

text.p: Rail soymeal basis offers continued to weaken Wednesday at several locations in reaction to weak demand and ample supplies at processors, dealers said.
Feed demand has eased as well. Hot weather in the south and southeast has slowed hog and poultry feed consumption, they said.

Buyers appear to have immediate needs covered, but may have to come to the market in a week or so once current supplies are used up. Recent buying strategies involved buying for prompt shipment because buyers did not want to pay the higher prices for July or August material.
Offers were down $1.00 per ton at $10 over CBOT July for rail soymeal, basis Decatur, Ill. or Danville, Ill. and down $2.00 at $18.00 over CBOT July for truck soymeal basis Frankfort, Ind.
